> Dog daycare in Collingwood, Ontario serving Blue Mountain, Wasaga Beach, Clearview and Thornbury. Small dog daycare, big dog daycare, puppy daycare, dog walking, and dog boarding (little dogs only). Owner-operated by Tracie.

## About

Dogs R Us Collingwood offers dog daycare in Collingwood, Ontario with separate small dog daycare and big dog daycare areas. Proudly serving Collingwood, Ontario — including Blue Mountain, Wasaga Beach, Clearview and Thornbury. Big dog daycare is now open. Puppy daycare is available from 4 months with required vaccines. The two size groups never mix. Every dog needs a Meet & Greet and a signed waiver before daycare.

## Service area

- Collingwood, Ontario
- Blue Mountain / The Blue Mountains
- Wasaga Beach
- Clearview
- Thornbury
- Grey County / Georgian Bay area

## Services

- Dog daycare in Collingwood (small dog daycare and big dog daycare) — full day $50, half day $30 (up to 5 hrs), shoppers special $20 (up to 3 hrs); +HST
- Dog walking (little and big dogs, same rates) — 15 min $10, 30 min $15, 5-walk package $65, 10-walk package $130
- Dog boarding in Collingwood — little dogs only — $75 +HST / 24 hours (includes a full daycare day)
- Treats R Us — house-made dehydrated single-ingredient treats; shipping available

## Booking

No online booking forms. Call or text Tracie at 705-606-4145. Documents: waiver and policy PDFs linked from the site FAQ.
